children: The Central Bank of Egypt kept its key interest rate unchanged at 19% at its September 2026 meeting, in line with market expectations amid still-high inflation and regional and energy shocks.
This marked the sixth consecutive meeting with rates on hold.
The CBE said the global outlook remains uncertain due to geopolitical tensions, tighter financial conditions, and renewed supply chain disruptions.
Domestic economic activity continued to moderate due to regional tensions, while the projected output gap suggests limited demand-side inflationary pressures in the short term.
Annual headline inflation eased marginally, while core inflation remained relatively stable.
The CBE revised its inflation forecast downward, but said risks remain tilted to the upside amid renewed regional hostilities.
It added that the current degree of policy restrictiveness should help buffer these risks and preserve the projected disinflation path.

title: Egypt Holds Rate for Sixth Straight Meeting
